newsitem.title: CHINA: U.S. secretary of state arrives in China.
newsitem.headline: U.S. secretary of state arrives in China.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher arrived in Beijing on Tuesday for the highest level visit by a U.S. official to China in more than two years.
China had sent mixed signals to the United States before Christopher's arrival, combining toughness with conciliation on a range of issues that have tangled Sino-American ties.
Relations between China and the United States have been strained by a series of disputes on issues such as human rights, arms proliferation, Taiwan and trade.
Christopher's visit is likely to be the first in a series of senior-level contacts in the months ahead aimed at keeping those conflicts from boiling over.

Clinton will confer with President Jiang Zemin in Manila on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit this month and plans are under discussion for an exchange of visits between the two leaders.
